text:
A student pushes a drawing pin (thumb tack) into a notice board.
pin head
pin tip
Which statement about the pin tip is correct?
A
The area of the pin tip is large so that the pressure is high.
B
The area of the pin tip is large so that the pressure is low.
C
The area of the pin tip is small so that the pressure is high.
D
The area of the pin tip is small so that the pressure is low.

options.label: A
options.text: The area of the pin tip is large so that the pressure is high.

options.label: B
options.text: The area of the pin tip is large so that the pressure is low.

options.label: C
options.text: The area of the pin tip is small so that the pressure is high.

options.label: D
options.text: The area of the pin tip is small so that the pressure is low.
